investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Related Alerts: SOC-99398 (User Login Location Anomaly at 2026-02-10T10:45:00Z from same IP)
investigation_notes.Description: A deletion of a production Network Security Group (nsg-prod-edge-01 in rg-baltic-prod-connectivity) succeeded at 2026-02-10T14:45:00Z (16:45 EET), initiated by mateo.rodriguez@globalcorp.ee, a Senior DevOps Engineer with Contributor privileges. The activity occurred during normal Estonian working hours and the account used FIDO/MFA, which supports legitimacy, but the caller IP originates from Bogotá, Colombia and a related login-location anomaly from the same IP was observed earlier the same day. Given the high-impact nature of removing a production NSG combined with the geographic anomaly and lack of other correlated deployment events, this alert is classified as High Priority to ensure immediate verification and potential escalation.
